Class Manager

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.User
com.uni.models.Employee
com.uni.models.Manager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Manager extends Employee
Academic manager. Approves registrations, assigns teachers to courses, generates statistical reports, and can promote any user to a Researcher via makeResearcher(User) (Decorator pattern).
